setups.name: Double Agree
setups.where: Both market models 2+ pts off the line
setups.why: Both of our market models (a linear model and a tree model, built differently) expect this side to beat the line by 2+ points.
setups.note: Linear and tree market models both 2+ pts on the same side. 2024-26 held out at the morning line: 101-59 (63.1%)

setups.name: Sharp Agrees
setups.where: Pinnacle leans our way and the US books haven't moved
setups.why: Pinnacle, the book professional bettors use, already leans 0.5+ points toward our side while the US books haven't moved: our model and the sharp money agree. Raises the pick's stake by 0.5u.
setups.note: A tag on a Market Edge pick, not its own bet: raises the stake 0.5u. Level with the US books: 58-59%

setups.name: Market Edge 3+
setups.where: Market model 3+ pts off the line
setups.why: The market model expects this side to beat the line by 3+ points (its strongest tier).
setups.note: 2024-26 held out at the morning line: 36-20 (64.3%)

setups.name: Market Edge 2+
setups.where: Market model 2-3 pts off the line
setups.why: The market model expects this side to beat the line by 2-3 points.
setups.note: 2024-26 held out at the morning line: 184-116 (61.3%), line moved our way by tip

setups.name: Market Edge
setups.where: Market model 1.5-2 pts off the line
setups.why: The market model expects this side to beat the line by 1.5-2 points.
setups.note: 2024-26 held out at the morning line: 379-250 (60.3%)

setups.name: Market Total
setups.where: Totals model 2+ pts off the total, crew known
setups.why: The totals market model (pace, both teams' shooting luck, the total's moves and the REFEREE CREW) expects the game to beat the total by 2+ points. Paper until we confirm crews are posted before tip.
setups.note: Paper until referee crews are confirmed posted before tip
